abilities.name: Brutal Power
abilities.effect: Add 1 to this unit's power level while there are any friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** units that have 10 or more models wholly within 12" of it.

abilities.name: Flattened into the Mud
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice and add the number of **momentum points** this unit has to the roll. On a 5+, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Momentum
abilities.effect:
Each time this unit has charged as a result of using a **^^Charge^^** ability, it gains 1 **momentum point**. Each time it uses a **^^Run^^** ability, it gains 2 **momentum points**. It can have a maximum of 3 **momentum points** at once.
Add the number of **momentum points** this unit has to the Damage characteristic of its **^^Maw-grunta's Tusks^^**. At the end of each battle round, subtract 1 from its **momentum points**, to a minimum of 0.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its ** Maw-krusha's Fists and Tail** is 5.

abilities.name: Destructive Bulk
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a D3. On a 2+, this unit can move 2D6". It can move through  the combat range of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the D3 roll. If the target is **^^Infantry^^**, double the mortal damage inflicted.

abilities.name: Strength From Victory
abilities.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, give this unit a **Waaagh! token**, to a maximum of 3.
Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's weapons for each **Waaagh! token** it has.

abilities.name: Lead da Brutes
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a **^^Fight^^** ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly **^^Brute^^** unit that has not used a **^^Fight^^** ability  this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The  target can be picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability immediately after the **^^Fight^^** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Strength From Victory
abilities.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, give this unit a **Waaagh! token**, to a maximum of 3.
Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's weapons for each **Waaagh! token** it has.

abilities.name: Get In There And Wallop 'Em!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ironjawz unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that was not set up this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, when you use the 'Mighty Destroyers' ability, you can pick that friendly unit to be a second target.

abilities.name: You Ain't Gonna Show Me Up
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect:
If this unit used a Fight ability this turn, spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's Boss-choppa for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

abilities.name: Rhythm of Destruction
abilities.effect: If any enemy models were slain this turn by this unit's combat attacks, give this unit D3 ritual points.

abilities.name: Gore-grunta Charge
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted (if any) if the target is **^^Cavalry^^**.

abilities.name: Berserkers
abilities.effect: This unit can use a **^^Run^^** ability and still use **^^Charge^^** abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: Unleashed Rage
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Strike-first^^** if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a shield bash roll of D6 for each model in this unit that is within 3" of the target. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Iron-fisted Commander
abilities.effect: If a friendly **Ardboyz** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Get Bashin'!
abilities.effect: Add 1 to shield bash rolls for friendly **Ardboyz** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Klonk
abilities.effect: **Klonk** is a token. You can re-roll forgin' rolls for this unit while this unit's **Klonk** is on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove this unit's **Klonk** from the battlefield after the **^^Attack^^** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

abilities.name: Power of da Great Green God
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly **^^Ironjawz Infantry^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a forgin' roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is armed with **Grunta-tongs**. On a 4+, the target's melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Ward-smashing Choppa
abilities.effect: If an attack made with this unit's **^^Ward-smashing Choppa^^** scores a hit, the target has the **^^Ward‑smashed^^** keyword for the rest of the battle. Ward rolls cannot be made for a **^^Ward‑smashed^^** unit even if this unit has been destroyed.

abilities.name: You Messin'?
abilities.effect: Enemy units with a Health characteristic of 1 or 2 cannot contest objectives while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: You Call Dat A Punch?
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an Attack ability that targeted this unit
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Bigteef's Fists and Tail** is 6.

abilities.name: Monster Grapple
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target's weapons. You must pick a **Companion** weapon if it has any. Halve the Attacks characteristic of that weapon (rounding up) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Voice of Gork
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a **^^Waaagh!^^** ability
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.

abilities.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, give this unit a **Waaagh! token**, to a maximum of 3.
Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's weapons for each **Waaagh! token** it has.

abilities.effect: This unit can use a **^^Run^^** ability and still use **^^Charge^^** abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Maw-grunta's Tusks** is 3.

abilities.name: Head of the Stampede
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick up to 3 friendly **^^Maw‑grunta^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit that charged this turn to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 **momentum point** to each target.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Momentum
abilities.effect:
Each time this unit has charged as a result of using a **^^Charge^^** ability, it gains 1 **momentum point**. Each time it uses a **^^Run^^** ability, it gains 2 **momentum points**. It can have a maximum of 3 **momentum points** at once.
Add the number of **momentum points** this unit has to the Damage characteristic of its **^^Maw-grunta's Tusks^^**. At the end of each battle round, subtract 1 from its **momentum points**, to a minimum of 0.

abilities.name: Carve a Path
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect:
If this unit is in combat, it can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat.
Then, pick each enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this unit gains 2 **momentum points**.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Momentum
abilities.effect:
Each time this unit has charged as a result of using a **^^Charge^^** ability, it gains 1 **momentum point**. Each time it uses a **^^Run^^** ability, it gains 2 **momentum points**. It can have a maximum of 3 **momentum points** at once.
Add the number of **momentum points** this unit has to the Damage characteristic of its **^^Maw-grunta's Tusks^^**. At the end of each battle round, subtract 1 from its **momentum points**, to a minimum of 0.

abilities.name: Man da Tower!
abilities.effect:
While this terrain feature has a Shouty Boss:
• The Shouty Boss cannot use **^^Move^^** abilities.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to the Shouty Boss, measure to this terrain feature instead.
• All attacks that would target the Shouty Boss target this terrain feature instead.
• If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Shouty Boss. Then, set up the Shouty Boss on the battlefield within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Shouty Boss. If it is not possible to set up the Shouty Boss, it is slain.

abilities.name: Up We Go!
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Shouty Boss , pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz Infantry Hero^^** that is not in combat and is within 3" of it  to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a Shouty Boss (see 'Man da Tower').

abilities.name: Aggressively Bossy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this terrain feature has a Shouty Boss. On a 4+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to the target until the start of your next turn:
***Dat's Ours, Ya Git!:*** Subtract 3 from the target's control score.
***Zog Off Wiv Ya Magic!:*** Subtract 1 from casting rolls and/or chanting rolls for the target.
***Oi! Hold it!:*** Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

abilities.name: I'm Off!
abilities.effect: If this terrain feature has a Shouty Boss that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Shouty Boss on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shouty Boss.

abilities.name: Ironjawz Waaagh!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz Hero^^** to be the target. You cannot pick the same **^^Hero^^** to be the target of this ability more than once per battle.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the following effects apply to friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** units while they are wholly within 18" of the target:
• Add 1 to charge rolls for those units.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those units' melee weapons.

abilities.name: Mighty Destroyers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** unit that was not set up this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can move up to 3". It can move into combat. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Bash 'Em, Ladz
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target's melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn

abilities.name: Da Great Big Green Hand of Gork
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 24" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Mighty 'Eadbutt
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the target is a **^^Wizard^^**, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target instead.

abilities.name: Chimeric Mantle
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract D3 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's **Companion** weapons while it is in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Weird Skullz
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. If the target is within 12" of this unit, add 1 to the roll. On a 4+:
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• Subtract 1 from the target's power level until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Horn of Shattatusk
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Ironjawz Waaagh!' ability and picked this unit to be the target
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.

abilities.name: Trophy Skulls
abilities.effect: Add 10 to this unit's control score.

abilities.name: Armour of Gork
abilities.effect: This unit has **^^Ward (6+)^^**.

abilities.name: Amberbone Whetstone
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of this unit's weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Spirit of Gork
abilities.effect: Friendly **^^Ironjawz Infantry^^** units have **^^Ward (6+)^^** while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **^^Ironjawz Wizards^^** or **^^Priests^^**.

abilities.name: Natural Disaster
abilities.effect: If you make an unmodified charge roll of 8+ for a friendly non-**^^Hero Ironjawz^^** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: 'Ere We Come
abilities.effect: Add the number of enemy units that have been destroyed this battle to the Move characteristic of friendly **Gore-gruntas** and **^^Maw-grunta^^** units, to a maximum of +4.

abilities.name: Smashin' and Bashin'
abilities.effect: The first time each turn that an enemy unit is destroyed by a **^^Fight^^** ability used by a friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** unit, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by the next friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** unit that is picked to use a **^^Fight^^** ability for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Hulking Brute
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If this unit's unmodified charge roll this turn was 8+, roll a D6 instead of a D3.

abilities.name: Mega Bossy
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.

abilities.name: An Eye for da Fight
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

abilities.name: Fixin' Beat
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: **Heal (D6)** the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (D3+3)** the target instead.

abilities.name: Get 'Em Beat
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: Killa Beat
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick up to 2 eligible units to be the targets instead of 1.

abilities.name: Summon Morkspit Marsh
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Morkspit Marsh** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Morkspit Marsh** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Summon Foot of Gork
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Foot of Gork** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Foot of Gork** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Foot of Gork** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Summon Gork-Roara
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly **Gork-Roara** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Ironjawz Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a **Gork-Roara** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Big 'Un
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's **Companion** weapons.

abilities.name: Angry 'Un
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your fury level. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Fast 'Un
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit was not set up this turn, it can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Mad 'Un
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any models are slain by this ability, after those models are removed from the battlefield, if this unit is still in combat, this unit can immediately use this ability again.
